references.text: Describes the final fate of the king of Ai, who was executed and hanged on a tree, showing what happened after he was taken captive.
Five Canaanite kings were found hidden in a cave, a similar situation where kings were captured during Joshua's campaign.
The five kings were brought before Joshua, just as the king of Ai was brought before him.
The Mosaic law concerning warfare and the treatment of enemies in cities that were captured.
The conquest of Jericho, a city previously completely destroyed under Joshua's leadership, part of the same campaign.
Adoni-Besek was captured and taken prisoner by the tribe of Israel, similar to the capture of an enemy king.
